description: Reusable skills and plugins from CodFrm.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development, end to end. The spec settles what to build, the plan settles how: agreed design → isolated worktree → approved spec committed on its branch → plan → one TDD round per task, each commit reviewed by a subagent that did not write it → two static wrap-up reviews → main-session runtime verification and reproducible report. Plus init, for AGENTS.md, layered docs and lint guardrails wired into CI.
